name: validate-schematron
description: Validates XML/TEI documents against Schematron rules (from a .sch, an ODD or a RelaxNG with embedded rules) and, optionally, RelaxNG structure via jing, as you type. Requires Python 3 with the saxonche and lxml libraries: see 'Before you start'.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the extension still validates, but it ignores the folder's own settings for the programs it runs (pythonPath, validatorPath, jingPath) and uses only your user settings.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Validation runs Python and jing on files on disk.

schematron.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that has the saxonche and lxml libraries. Leave it empty to use the one made by py-schematron's installer, if it is installed (see 'Schematron: Setup Guide'), or else python3. Otherwise, for example ~/.venvs/schematron/bin/python (Linux, macOS) or %USERPROFILE%\.venvs\schematron\Scripts\python.exe (Windows); the command 'Schematron: Select Python Interpreter…' sets it.

schematron.validatorPath.description: Path to py-schematron.py. Empty: use the copy bundled with the extension. Point it at your own checkout to use the ODD route (-o), which needs odds/extract-isosch.xsl next to the script.

schematron.schema.description: Schema to validate against (relative to the workspace folder). Empty: auto-detect from the document's <?xml-model?> processing instructions.

enumDescriptions: RelaxNG generated from an ODD: its embedded Schematron is harvested (-r)
ISO Schematron file, used as is (-s)
ODD with embedded Schematron, extracted with extract-isosch.xsl (-o)
schematron.schemaType.description: Type of the file in schematron.schema (ignored when auto-detecting).

schematron.validateOnOpen.description: Validate XML files when they are opened.

schematron.validateOnSave.description: Validate XML files when they are saved.

schematron.validateOnChange.description: Validate XML files as you type (unsaved changes included), once typing pauses for schematron.changeDelayMs.

schematron.changeDelayMs.description: How long typing must pause before validating unsaved changes (milliseconds).

schematron.relaxng.enabled.description: Also check structure with jing when the schema source is a RelaxNG file.

schematron.jingPath.description: jing for the RelaxNG layer: a command, or a jing.jar, which is run with Java (java -jar), as on Windows, which has no jing command. Empty: $JING, or the jing.jar named by $JING_JAR, or jing.

schematron.timeoutSeconds.description: Abort a validation run after this many seconds.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle-validator
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run bundle-validator && node out/test/integration/runTest.js
